policy.dynamicLinking: Dynamically linked against the host glibc via the host-provided loader (ld-linux-x86-64.so.2). Fully static binaries are out of scope for Core 1.
policy.kernelBaseline: Linux 5.10 or newer with user namespaces available for the sandbox.
policy.hostProvided: The core system runtime present on every conforming host: glibc, libgcc_s, the dynamic loader, and the vDSO. Never bundled.
policy.mustBundle: Every other shared library the application needs, carried in the payload.
policy.forbidden: Host GPU/graphics/accelerator driver interfaces (libGL, libEGL, libcuda, libvulkan, libdrm) — provided by the host, never bundled.
policy.filesystem: A read-only application image plus private, writable data, cache and temp roots (FORMAT-0.1 §9). No ambient filesystem access.
policy.environment: A sanitized environment allow-list; dangerous variables (LD_PRELOAD, LD_LIBRARY_PATH) are stripped.
policy.isolation: The Linux baseline sandbox: read-only app image, private data/cache/temp, environment sanitization, and network denied unless granted.
policy.graphics: Headless/terminal applications only in Core 1. GUI forwarding is out of scope.
policy.network: No network unless the application declares and the user approves the network permission; otherwise the network namespace is unshared.
policy.dataPaths: Per-App persistent data survives update/rollback; cache is disposable; temp is per-launch and private.
policy.claimLanguage: Targets Tux32 Core 1. Verified against the Core 1 glibc symbol ceiling. Core Portable does not mean every arbitrary Linux binary is portable; runtime dlopen dependencies may require explicit declaration.
policy.conformance: A runtime conforms to Core 1 when it provides the host interface with a glibc of at least 2.31, the stated kernel/isolation capabilities, and runs a conforming package's exact signed artifact unchanged.
